results.guideline_text:
Using Table 14.1.6: Treatment Summary - Safety Population (RP Patients only), generate the Extent of Exposure subsection for the Safety Results.
Instructions:
· Confirm the safety population (all patients receiving ≥1 dose); note and explain any exclusions if reported.
· Summarize duration of exposure, including mean/median (and range if available) and the number of patients across reported duration categories. Include subgroup summaries (e.g., age, sex, race, disease/severity) if present in the table.
· Summarize dose exposure, including mean/median dose, definition of dose used (e.g., maximum, longest exposure, mean daily), numbers of patients at each dose level, and any combined dose-duration information. State dose units. Include subgroup breakdowns if available.
· Report drug concentration data (e.g., Cmax, AUC, concentration at event) only if provided; otherwise state that such data are not available.
Rules:
· Use only data from the table; do not infer missing information.
· If a data element is absent, state "Data not available."
· Write in clear, concise, regulatory-appropriate narrative suitable for direct CSR inclusion.
Output:
A finalized Extent of Exposure paragraph(s) for the Safety Results section.
